interpretation: Actor-family extension on questions shared with the checkpoint and budget studies. Qwen executions are newly acquired; preserve question pairing for cross-study comparisons. The exported answer-case identifiers preserve shared uncertainty within this study.
predictor_input: Use only the input object for prediction. Unit identifiers join records and carry no permitted predictive features. Reward, strata and resource fields are evaluator-side data.
measurement: Flash and Pro frozen-reference-equivalence endpoints, paired disagreement sensitivity andrawEM. Human ratings:0. Reused answer labels andshared execution origins remain in source records.
timing: Original forecasts and primary prediction files precede their corresponding actor outcomes. Additional parent-constant controls, when present, derive retrospectively from prefrozen source fits. New algorithms on these released outcomes are evaluated as offline benchmarks.

actor_registration.classification: Secondary prospective actor-family extension on previously studied questions; new actor outcomes.
actor_registration.theme: Use execution experience to improve estimates of whether continued search is worthwhile.
actor_registration.selection: The complete fixed 40/80 cohort of the prior DeepSeek budget study. No local benchmark actor output exists at registration.

actor.runtime: llama.cpp b11669, locally compiled with CUDA 12.8.93
actor.seed: One preassigned random integer per draw; add the model-call step for later calls.
actor.history: Original API messages; the official embedded Qwen chat template renders each request.

actor_registration.execution: Reuse the native paired continuation executor. THINK receives the final-answer instruction and tool_choice none. SEARCH may finish or search with automatic tool choice. All reasoning, tool arguments and final output share the 8192 completion ceiling. The server disables context shifting. Context overflow is a scored delivery failure.
actor_registration.forecasts: Flash and Pro each forecast all 120 units before any Qwen actor execution. Forecast inputs describe Qwen, quantization, sampling, context, tools and finite budgets. Algorithmic invalid forecasts retain 0.5/0.5; transport failures remain pending.
actor_registration.fitting: Use only the forty Qwen development questions and Flash reference-equivalence outcomes. Four stratified folds select penalties in the existing implementations. Freeze fitted maps, test forecasts and development mean costs before all test actors.
actor_registration.source_controls: Tavily120 maps match each forecaster. DeepSeek40 maps exist for Flash forecasts and isolate actor-family transfer under the same search interface and question split. Each transferred map retains its own training constant.
actor_registration.primary_extension_comparisons: On all eighty test questions, Flash forecasts and Flash judgments: shared-input affine versus raw effect risk, and affine versus local constant average Brier. Both one-sided 97.5% upper bounds must be below zero for this replication criterion. This is a secondary extension with its own stated target; the original 400-question stronger primary criterion remains unchanged.
actor_registration.strong_controls: Report paired effect and Brier differences against independent affine with matched folds, armwise shared inputs, learned level plus mean gain, and all source constants. Raw correction, conditional gain skill and controller utility remain distinct claims.
actor_registration.measurement: Reuse the existing answer-blind Flash/Pro reference-equivalence pipeline, automatic exact-reference matches and identical-answer reuse. Retain the paired-judge and raw-EM endpoints. Carry forward the independent question-source audit; report all/source-supported and shared-unknown-reference bounds. AI reviews remain AI reviews.
actor_registration.inference: 10,000 support-component bootstrap samples with question-weighted means. Repeats and teachers do not multiply question count. Other methods, endpoints and subsets are secondary descriptive intervals.

planning_precision.source: The same eighty questions in the completed DeepSeek t8192_s3 study, with 71 support components.
planning_precision.interpretation: These normal-approximation values use 2.8016 times the source bootstrap standard error for a 2.5% one-sided test. Actor transfer can change variance. The fixed matched cohort tests sizeable correction effects; it does not guarantee detection of small differences between fitted calibrators.

actor_registration.routing: Freeze the mean SEARCH-minus-THINK token cost from Qwen development. Route using forecast gain minus lambda times that cost, with THINK on ties. Report all five fixed lambda values. Per-query predictors pay their DeepSeek forecast tokens; constants and zero-effect policies require no query forecast. Actor and predictor token totals also remain separately reported because tokenizers and hardware differ.
actor_registration.failures: Length, context and malformed output score as delivery failures. Stop acquisition on the first infrastructure failure, retain partial work, and resolve the service before resuming. No outcome-based subgroup selection, early stopping or gate-driven removal.
actor_registration.runtime: The measured engineering range of 65-76 generated tokens/s implies about 29-34 hours at the full completion ceiling, before prompt processing and search. Actual task runtime is unknown at registration.
